David_1: son of Jesse (Ruth 4:17), King of Israel (2 Samuel 5:3)
Ahijah_1: priest at Shiloh, nephew of Ichabod (1 SA 14:3), and prophet (1 Kings 11:29)
Jeroboam_1: Solomon's servant, son of Nebat, who rebelled against him (1 Kings 11:26), and was later made king of Israel (1 Kings 12:20)
Nebat_1: father of Jeroboam, an Ephraimite of Zeredah (1 Kings 11:26)
Rehoboam_1: son of Solomon who became king after him (1 Kings 11:43)
